meta.title: xopc — A Self-hosted Personal AI Runtime
meta.description: Run AI on your hardware. Connect models, agents, sessions, projects, goals, notes, workflows, and automations across terminal, web, desktop, mobile, and messengers.
meta.ogDescription: xopc is a self-hosted, local-first personal AI runtime. Own your data, keys, and environment while long-running work stays resumable, executable, and triggerable.

hero.desc: A self-hosted, local-first personal AI runtime connecting models, agents, durable state, workflows, automations, and every surface you use. You own the data, keys, and environment.

download.hackableComment: # Source install — for contributors and deep customization
download.hackablePnpmInstallCommand: cd xopc && corepack enable && pnpm install
download.hackablePnpmComment2: # Run from source; build then onboard
download.hackablePnpmOnboardCommand: pnpm run build && pnpm exec xopc onboard
download.title: Up and running in 30 seconds.
download.subtitle: One command installs Node.js and xopc, then walks you through onboarding — macOS, Linux, or Windows.
download.quickInstallComment: # One command — macOS, Linux, and Windows.
download.quickInstallFootnote: Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The one-liner installs Node.js and everything else for you. Hackable clones from git for local hacking. Switch tabs for npm or desktop downloads.
download.advancedSubtitle: If you already have Node.js 22+ and prefer the package manager route.
download.npmBody: Node.js 22+ required. pnpm is also supported: pnpm add -g @xopcai/xopc. China mirror: npm install -g @xopcai/xopc --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com. Then chat: xopc tui --local
download.npmOnboardBody: Interactive onboarding — pick your model and add API keys. Faster path: xopc onboard --quick
download.desktopSubtitle: Download Electron builds for macOS, Windows, or Linux from GitHub Releases.

features.desc: xopc puts models, agents, durable state, and execution into an environment you control instead of piling features into another chat window.

items.title: Bring your own API keys. Choose any model.
items.body: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Bedrock, Azure, and 20+ providers are built in. Run fully local inference or mix cloud and local models; switch with one config line and avoid vendor lock-in.

items.title: Durable state, not one context window.
items.body: Sessions, projects, goals, notes, workspaces, and run history have explicit ownership. Resume long-running work without reconstructing it every time.

items.title: Projects, Goals, and Notes have distinct jobs.
items.body: Projects group context, Goals track status, blockers, and next actions, while Notes capture text, voice, images, and attachments wherever input happens.

items.title: Observable workflows. Traceable automations.
items.body: Organize complex execution into phases and subagents, then trigger it on schedules, manually, or from webhooks. Progress, results, failures, and retries stay visible.

items.title: Agent capability boundaries are explicit.
items.body: Give each agent its own identity, responsibilities, model roles, workspace, tool policy, skills, memory, and boundaries.

items.title: Add capabilities only when needed.
items.body: Skills provide task methods, Extensions add tools, channels, and UI, and Connectors bring in external capabilities while the core stays clear.

items.title: Your machine. Your rules.
items.body: xopc runs on your hardware. Conversations, project context, and local state stay in your xopc runtime. API keys stay in your config. No mandatory cloud. No surprise bills.

operator.name: XOPC Worker
operator.metaTitle: XOPC Worker | A computer agent you can delegate to
operator.metaDescription: Plan, act, confirm, and report on everyday computer work in your environment—while you keep control of the data, keys, and runtime.
operator.desc: XOPC Worker understands a goal, plans the work, uses web and connected tools in your environment, asks before consequential actions, and returns a clear record with the result.

media.title: Needed: complete Worker task demo
media.action: Record goal → plan → browser/tool execution → approval → result, then export it to the file below

flow.title: Delegate without disappearing from the loop.
flow.desc: Worker is more than a few automated clicks. It turns work into a process you can understand, inspect, and resume.

steps.title: Set the goal
steps.body: Describe what needs to move forward and what a useful result looks like.

steps.title: See the plan
steps.body: Review the breakdown before execution, then add context or boundaries when needed.

steps.title: Act and pause
steps.body: The agent uses allowed tools to progress, then stops when a decision belongs to you.

steps.title: Deliver and continue
steps.body: Receive the result and its record, with a clear next step instead of a one-off chat.

capabilities.title: From a goal to work already in motion.
capabilities.desc: Connect web, files, information entry points, and durable workflows to one observable agent runtime.

items.title: Goal decomposition
items.body: Organize a natural-language objective into trackable tasks and steps instead of forcing complex work into one prompt.

items.title: Cross-tool execution
items.body: Let work move through the browser, files, and connected work entry points.

items.title: Human in the loop
items.body: Keep decisions, authorizations, and sending actions that matter with you.

items.title: Durable context
items.body: Use Sessions, Projects, Goals, and Workflows to retain state so follow-up work can continue.

items.title: Research and decision preparation
items.body: Gather information from multiple sources and turn it into notes, a table, or grounded next steps.

items.title: Recurring back-office work
items.body: Turn a fixed process into observable tasks, taking over only at exceptions or key decisions.

items.title: Status synthesis and weekly updates
items.body: Shape scattered progress, source material, and todos into a deliverable that can keep evolving.

items.title: Cross-app personal tasks
items.body: Let a goal travel through everyday tools instead of being trapped in a chat window.

trust.title: Visible, controllable, and yours.
items: Local-first: you control the data, keys, and runtime environment.
Visible process: know what the agent is doing and where it is waiting.
Clear boundaries: return high-impact actions to a person for confirmation.

cross.title: Need an agent to change a local codebase?
cross.desc: XOPC Code organizes coding agents, project workspaces, change review, and verification records into another complete delivery path.

code.name: XOPC Code
code.metaTitle: XOPC Code | Verifiable coding agents in local repositories
code.metaDescription: Connect Codex, Claude Code, and other coding capabilities to a local workspace, with built-in Codebase Memory for reviewable, verifiable code changes.
code.desc: XOPC Code organizes coding work in your local project: understand the repository, make a plan, change code, run verification, and clearly present the diff and result. Built-in Codebase Memory turns the repository into a queryable knowledge graph, so agents do not have to guess context file by file.

media.title: Needed: complete Code delivery demo
media.action: Record request → repository understanding → change → test/check → diff summary, then export it to the file below

flow.title: Make the coding process a reviewable loop.
flow.desc: The point is not how much code appears at once; it is understanding, changing, validating, and handing off a real project responsibly.

steps.title: Understand the project
steps.body: Build task-relevant project context from the request and local workspace.

steps.title: Propose a plan
steps.body: Clarify the implementation path, impact area, and required verification before editing.

steps.title: Make the change
steps.body: Use connected coding agents to progress implementation and fixes in the workspace.

steps.title: Review and verify
steps.body: Use the diff, commands, and verification results to show what changed and what deserves attention.

capabilities.title: Bring coding capability into the work, not another silo.
capabilities.desc: XOPC Code gives Codex, Claude Code, and other coding capabilities project context, task structure, and a reviewable delivery surface; Codebase Memory makes code structure, relationships, and impact scope part of that engineering understanding.

items.title: Use your coding agents
items.body: Connect the coding capability you prefer for the task instead of being locked to one model or tool.

items.title: Codebase Memory
items.body: Use a built-in code knowledge graph for functions, types, call chains, routes, and cross-service relationships—then combine semantic search, structural queries, and impact analysis to find relevant code quickly.

items.title: Trackable changes
items.body: Organize code changes, executed commands, and verification results into a record people can review.

items.title: From code into workflow
items.body: Let coding tasks continue through xopc Goals, Workflows, and surfaces instead of ending at a terminal.

items.title: From issue to implementation plan
items.body: Understand the request and impact area before receiving a reviewable path to implementation.

items.title: Bug investigation and repair
items.body: Trace a problem in the real repository, make the fix, and return the verification result.

items.title: Refactoring and test coverage
items.body: Break structural change into verifiable steps to reduce the risk of changing code without checking outcomes.

items.title: Codebase research and technical proposals
items.body: Query Codebase Memory for architecture, call paths, and impact scope, then turn repository exploration into technical conclusions and a handoff-ready next-step plan.

trust.title: Give every change a basis.
items: Your workspace: work around local projects and established tools.
Your choice: connect different coding agents and providers for different tasks.
Your review: use changes and verification records to decide whether to accept delivery.

cross.title: Need an agent to progress everyday computer work?
cross.desc: XOPC Worker organizes goals, tool execution, approvals, and durable state into a delivery path for real-world tasks.

gateway.name: XOPC Gateway
gateway.metaTitle: XOPC Gateway | Make a local AI runtime a connected service
gateway.metaDescription: Connect a local xopc runtime to web, mobile, messaging channels, and APIs while keeping control of configuration, identity, and data boundaries.
gateway.desc: XOPC Gateway brings the agents, state, and workflows running in your environment to web, mobile, messaging channels, and APIs. It is a unified entry point—not another isolated backend.

media.title: Needed: Gateway service connection demo
media.action: Record runtime start → channel or API connection → client response → service status, then export it to the file below

flow.kicker: From local runtime to service entry point
flow.title: Run once. Connect from many places.
flow.desc: Gateway exposes a running xopc instance as a controlled entry point, so clients and channels share the same state and execution capability.

steps.title: Run the runtime
steps.body: Start xopc in an environment you own, retaining local configuration, data, and provider choices.

steps.title: Connect surfaces
steps.body: Configure web, mobile, messaging channels, or other enabled client entry points.

steps.title: Serve clients
steps.body: Use Gateway APIs and streaming connections for clients to access sessions, tasks, and runtime status.

steps.title: Operate continuously
steps.body: Observe service and channel status so the local runtime can operate as a durable service.

capabilities.title: Put connection capability in one place.
capabilities.desc: Gateway provides a unified service layer for xopc clients, channels, and integrations, avoiding separate state and auth maintenance for every surface.

items.title: One service entry point
items.body: Let web, mobile, and other clients connect to one local runtime instead of duplicating agent state.

items.title: Gateway APIs and streams
items.body: Expose service interfaces for sessions, tasks, state, and real-time updates.

items.title: Channel runtimes
items.body: Load and manage messaging channel runtimes while keeping those conversation surfaces connected to core agent capability.

items.title: Service lifecycle
items.body: Manage the local Gateway around start, status, restart, and system-service operation.

items.title: Bring one runtime to more devices
items.body: Let web, mobile, desktop, and other surfaces see the same sessions, projects, and execution state.

items.title: Connect agents to messaging surfaces
items.body: Let people start and receive the same agent work through connected messaging channels.

items.title: Provide a backend for custom clients
items.body: Use APIs and streaming interfaces to bring xopc capability into existing products or internal tools.

items.title: Run continuously as a service
items.body: Keep a local AI runtime available over a manageable service lifecycle.

trust.kicker: The service remains in your control
trust.title: Connect more surfaces without giving up the boundary.
items: Local operation: start Gateway around your own device, configuration, and runtime environment.
Unified state: clients and channels connect to one runtime instead of scattered copies.
Operability: inspect service and channel status, then manage the lifecycle when needed.

cross.title: Need an agent to complete a concrete computer task?
cross.desc: XOPC Worker brings the runtime behind Gateway into everyday work that can be delegated and confirmed.

loop.titleLine2: Work that has a next step.
loop.desc: xopc separates long-running work into explicit state, execution, triggers, and access. It does not assume AI remembers everything; important information has a home, complex execution is observable, and follow-up can start again.

steps.title: Durable state
steps.body: Sessions, Projects, Goals, Notes, and Workspaces retain conversations, progress, source material, and artifacts.

steps.title: Explicit execution
steps.body: Agents use allowed tools and skills; Workflows organize multi-step or parallel work into inspectable runs.

steps.title: Active triggers
steps.body: Automations run agents or workflows on schedules, manually, or from webhooks, with visible success, failure, and retry history.

steps.title: Access anywhere
steps.body: Terminal, web, desktop, mobile, messengers, and HTTP/SSE APIs connect to the same runtime and state.
